About Ethereum

Ethereum is a programmable proof-of-stake blockchain whose native asset, ether, pays for transactions and smart-contract execution. Most DeFi, stablecoin and NFT activity, as well as many layer-2 networks, settle on Ethereum.

Where this ETH price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (ETH-USD), Binance (ETH/USDT) and Kraken (ETH/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade.
